about: Sakyamuni's right hand turned to the boon-granting gesture (与愿印) by grafting Sikhin's left hand, mirrored (issue #514; the 3D review's comment of 2026-11-21 and the T05 lead's four conditions). Stage frame of each figure: metres, x across (the figure's left at +x), y up from its seat, z toward the viewer; each figure stood at its height on its seat. tools/blender/varada.py reads this.

cut.note: just under the sleeve's edge, on the bare wrist (the sleeve is not carried over: Sakyamuni's right arm is bare)

keep.note: drop: a scrap of the sleeve's lower edge beside the little finger (a scrap of the knee's robe under the fingertips is still on: it shares its place and a shell with the fingers)

donor.note_sheet: a test for single open sheets (to drop the robe scrap at the fingertips) was tried and left out: the palm itself is an open sheet on these shells, and went with it
donor.note_scrap: the robe scrap at the fingertips, read off the donor hand in its own frame (u 0.66-0.88 of its length, 0.13-0.30 m out on the palm side; and past the little finger's edge, v over 0.2)

target.note: the forearm lies almost level along the thigh to the wrist at about (−1.72, 3.93, 1.2); the hand hangs from it over the knee, angled forward as Sikhin's is
target.note_face: the face-processed Sakyamuni (f1: closed eyes, lips forward -0.072, head bowed 10 degrees; #463), so the hand goes onto the face the hall will show

pose.note: the wrist stands at wrist0 carried forward by as much as lays the back of the hand 2 mm off the knee (solved in the run, the arm carried the same); pitch 0 here measures about +10° on the palm's plane (wrist, index root, little root), fingers about 15° from vertical
pose.note_bend: the fingers bend from the knuckles toward the back of the hand (negative), following the knee down past its fullest point (the 3D review's 2026-11-21 correction: knuckles ≤ 25° toward the back); the palm (wrist to knuckles, the first 40%) is not bent
pose.note_section: the hand's wrist and the forearm's end are both wider across (x) than deep: their flat sides are met at 0°, not turned 180° (the 3D review)

knee.note: round 2: the old hand pressed into the knee it lay on (the box seen from the front; its head stops under the old wrist, which the new hand covers); the knee's front is the left knee's mirrored front corrected to meet the right knee round the box's sides and foot
knee.note_inset: the knee's front under the old hand set back to where the left knee's front stands mirrored (z about 1.42 at y 3.4, as the reviewed round 1 had it): the old hand's back blurred stands about 0.3 m before it there

knee_r1.note: the old hand's place on the right knee: from the wrist down to the lotus, in front of the knee

arm.note: the shoulder's centre and the elbow read from sections of f1 (y 5.9: x -1.58..-1.25, z -1.25..-0.46; the forearm a round tube 0.2-0.25 m across lying on the thigh from z -0.3 to 1.45)
